sections.heading: Sign shapes and regulatory meanings
sections.markdown:
## Sign shapes and regulatory meanings

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A01
Regulatory signs specify permitted and prohibited actions, and bicyclists as well as other drivers must obey them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A01
A red circle crossed diagonally from its upper-left side toward its lower-right side means that the pictured action is prohibited. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A01
The wrong-way warning identifies an approach where travel in your present direction onto the one-way road or ramp is forbidden. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A01
The one-way instruction permits travel only in the direction indicated by its arrow. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A01
The do-not-enter meaning applies when traffic on the one-way road is coming toward your approach; do not continue onto that road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A01
A no-U-turn restriction forbids reversing direction through a U-turn at that intersection. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A01
A no-right-turn restriction prohibits turning right at that intersection. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A01
A keep-right instruction requires passing a median or obstruction on its right side. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A01
A reduced-speed-ahead warning announces an approaching area with a lower established limit. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A01
When multiple lanes carry traffic in your direction, a slower-traffic-keep-right instruction directs slower vehicles toward the rightmost lanes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A01
The handbook's posted-limit example of 55 miles per hour identifies the maximum allowed in that signed area, not a statewide default for every road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A01
The school-zone example applies its reduced limit while the yellow lights are flashing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A01
A no-right-turn-on-red restriction still prohibits that turn after the driver has come to a full stop. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R14 | anchor: A01
The bicycle-prohibition sign bars bicycles from entering the indicated roadway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

FACT_ID: sec08-R15 | anchor: A01
The truck-prohibition sign bars trucks from entering the indicated roadway. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=30]

Misconceptions: A complete stop does not cancel a sign forbidding a red-light turn; an example speed applies to its signed location.
Mnemonic: Shape, meaning, condition, action.
Glossary: A regulatory sign controls conduct; a guide sign supplies route or location information; a warning sign announces a hazard.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Image rights and the completeness of visual-recognition coverage remain unresolved; verbal captions are the only authored knowledge source here.
